focus_areas: Legibility and geometric correctness of the text/logo on the baseball.
Anatomical correctness of the hand gripping the ball, specifically finger joints and nail placement.
Regularity and physical embedding of the red stitching into the leather surface.
Boundary sharpness between the ball and the holding fingers.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the ball; AI often fails to render specific brand logos correctly, resulting in pseudo-text. Also, scrutinize the hand holding the ball—AI-generated hands often have extra fingers, missing joints, or fuse with held objects. The stitching should be examined for consistent depth and hole alignment; irregular stitching is a common artifact.

The background includes parts of the person's body (face, arm, legs) wearing dark clothing and red shorts, set against a dimly lit indoor environment.
